paper_logic.region: existing union of time-aggregated dynamic-LiDAR actor AABBs in first-vehicle frame, extended to fitted ground and margin0.25m
paper_logic.ground: existing static LiDAR lower-envelope deterministic plane fit; no new flat-plane fallback

addition_eligibility.input: complete Scene.getTrainCameras() collection with actual timestamps, world_view_transform and full_proj_transform
addition_eligibility.static_geometry: exact existing static SHM means at each training timestamp; static renderer time_shift=None
addition_eligibility.projection: center row-vector projection has positive clip_w, view_depth>0.2model units and NDCxy in[-1,1]
addition_eligibility.split: parent and both proposed moment-matching children must pass at least one actual training view
limitations: center-only gate can reject useful border footprints
a point not admitted is not evidence for RGB-noise causality

clone_policy.limit: one SGCM clone for each initial source lineage
clone_policy.same_step: at most one eligible representative per lineage, stable descending current-radius priority
clone_policy.inheritance: SGCM clone/split and generic clone/split all inherit source lineage and spent state
clone_policy.topology: metadata appended and pruned by exact source-parent/current-row indices through optimizer-aware methods
clone_policy.optimizer: old survivor moments and accumulated statistics retained; new children moments zero
clone_policy.resume: guarded resume rejects missing/misaligned lineage metadata

checkpoint.off_arm_capture: original legacy capture semantics; no lineage payload

integration.disabled_source_patch: enabled=False returns exact original text, including original newline bytes
integration.rng: guard and clone selection introduce no RNG calls

actual_region_mask_measurement.scope: near-clipped projection of time-aggregated Hd; no Gaussian checkpoint, occlusion or RGB contribution measured

verification.scientific_boundary: CPU eligibility/topology correctness does not establish image-quality improvement or RGB-noise causal explanation
